## Weekly model monitor

**Baseline:** Qwen3.6-35B-A3B UD-Q4_K_M

Checks official publisher accounts every Monday at 09:00 Europe/Copenhagen. It filters for conversational models, estimates whether a Q4 build leaves safe headroom on a 64-GB M1 Max, and labels benchmark contenders.

It never downloads or replaces a model. Connect your preferred notification node to **CONNECT NOTIFIER HERE** and use `{{$json.markdown}}` as its body.
